title: Bug Report Acceptance Contract
description: Criteria for high-quality bug reports that enable fast triage and reproduction

dimensions.name: Reproducibility
dimensions.criterion: Someone else can reproduce the bug following the steps

levels.definition: Step-by-step reproduction provided; includes environment (OS, version, config)
Reproduction steps provided but missing some context (version, browser, etc.)
No reproduction steps or only vague description

dimensions.name: Expected vs. Actual
dimensions.criterion: Report distinguishes what should happen from what actually happened

levels.definition: Both expected and actual behavior clearly documented with examples
Both present but one is vague or inferred
Only describes symptoms; doesn't clarify expected behavior

dimensions.name: Severity justification
dimensions.criterion: Severity claim is backed by business/user impact

levels.definition: Severity justified: describes who is affected and what they can't do
Severity reasonable but impact not fully explained

passing_criteria: reproducibility=PASS AND expected_vs_actual>=CONDITIONAL AND weighted avg >= 0.85
